Definition: properly, a cord (as twisted), i.e. (by implication) a boundary; by extension the territory inclosed
BiblicalUsage: 1) border, territory; 1a) border; 1b) territory (enclosed within boundary); 1c) region, territory (of darkness) (fig.)
